blocks.title: System-line icons
blocks.about: The markers in front of chat, join, leave, death, advancement and announcement lines, drawn white because the client multiplies a glyph by its text colour.

glyphs.name: separator
glyphs.about: The rule between a player's name and what they said, 3 by 7: a hairline, not a character.

glyphs.name: join
glyphs.about: Joined, 7 by 7: a triangle pointing in.

glyphs.name: leave
glyphs.about: Left, 7 by 7: the same triangle, mirrored.

glyphs.name: death
glyphs.about: Death, 7 by 7: a headstone, because the season answers a death with a grave.

glyphs.name: advancement
glyphs.about: Advancement, 7 by 7: a spark with four points, so it cannot be read as the donor star beside it.

glyphs.name: announce
glyphs.about: In front of a line the whole server is told, such as a milestone, an objective or a restart, 7 by 7: a horn.

fonts.about: Everything drawn on a chest row: a list entry's plate, its icon, its label. One font per chest row from the top, because a font's ascent is a glyph's only vertical control; row r draws every bitmap 18 r pixels lower than row 0.

glyphs.about: A list entry's plate, 158 by 14: the nine cells of its row, inset 2.
The active marker, 158 by 14: a hollow white frame 2 pixels wide, drawn last on its row.
A square button plate, 14 by 14: one slot cell inset 2.
The same, greyed: a page button with no page behind it.
The plate in a darker grey, 158 by 14, for a heading row that is not clickable.
A gold button plate, 50 by 14 over three cells, for a menu's action.
The same, 68 by 14 over four cells, as in the grave's take everything.
The entry plate at 122 by 14, for a row that carries controls on its right.
The entry plate at 140 by 14, over eight cells, for a row that carries one button on its right.

blocks.title: Row icons
blocks.about: One sheet of 8 by 8 pictograms, drawn white and tinted by the component. Hand-in, statistic, advancement and done are an objective's state, so exactly one is drawn per card.

glyphs.about: A house: a world's spawn.
A skull: where you last died.
A map pin: a place.
A cross: stop.
A left arrow: the previous page.
A right arrow: the next page.
A hand: a hand-in objective, the one kind you can click.
A pickaxe: a statistic objective, which counts itself.
A medal: an advancement objective, earned somewhere else entirely.
A tick: a finished objective, whichever kind it was.
An experience orb: the objective menu's share line.
A star: a favourite station.

blocks.title: The five-pixel sheet
blocks.about: A to Z, 0 to 9, punctuation, the German letters, a dot, and two blocks for a text bar, all capitals: MenuFont folds lower case onto them.

fonts.about: The moves every ui font shares by reference: 1 to 256 pixels back or forward.
Vanilla's letters and the 7 x 7 symbols, drawn the shift's number of pixels lower than ordinary text, so a title or a body line places a label on any row.

blocks.title: Symbols
blocks.about: The 7 x 7 symbols at the capitals' height. Each advances 8.

fonts.about: Plates, frames, the bar and the pill. Shift 0 puts the art's top on a dialog line's text row; 11 + 18 r on chest content row r.

blocks.title: Plate

blocks.title: Pill

fonts.about: The chest window for 1 to 6 rows, drawn from the title's anchor: bare, or with a frame on every content slot for a vanilla container. The build draws the textures from ChestPanelGeometry, 8 transparent rows above and below the window.
The dialog panels, drawn through the dialog's title with their top at the shift: 49 over a first plate line, 50 over a first text line, 43 over a frame 2 px above its line, 64 for the wheel.
The boxes a show_text hover draws over vanilla's tooltip, from the first line's text row: 20 high for one line, 10 n + 12 for n lines after a title, 10 n + 10 without.
